tools.name: search
tools.description: Search OpenPlanr docs passages. Optional section is the URL's first segment after /docs/ (for example skills or get-started).

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Read a docs page as Markdown. Accepts a /docs/... path or https://openplanr.dev/docs/... URL; query and anchor do not change the page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
